notes.title: Summer Time DLC now released
notes.notes: This set of [u][b]Summer Time[/b][/u] images is for the [u][b]Memory Lost-pairs[/b][/u] game. Every run has the images in different places, and covered. You need to click to show an image, and them remember where it is as you search for its matching image (and probably finding other matching pairs along the way).

notes.title: v1.1 triplets-400, achievements include slower achievements
notes.notes:
v1.1 is now active.
[list]
[*] When any achievement is earned, all lesser (slower) achievements for that same difficulty level are also earned.
[*] improved achievement images (for fastest achievement at each level).
[*] Triplets fastest achievement is now set to 400.
[*] Player can type Ctrl-Delete to erase all achievements for a clean restart.
[/list]
